experiments.accountDataCurrent: Users can export local overlays, fallbacks, keys, claims, activity, and signals, delete local Evolved data without touching official Toolhub, and get a home for future Evolved-only settings.
experiments.accountDataWhat: Manage Evolved-specific preferences and local data tied to your Toolhub sign-in.
experiments.apiCacheCurrent: Server-side ToolsDB cache stores anonymous GET /api/* responses with endpoint-specific TTLs, stale-if-error, ETag/Last-Modified, and browser stale-while-refresh support.
experiments.apiCacheNeed: api_cache table, proxy cache policy, and no caching for auth/session/write endpoints
experiments.apiCacheWhat: Make anonymous Toolhub reads fast and resilient for all users.
experiments.appShellCurrent: Critical shell CSS is inline, route modules are lazy-loaded, and failed dynamic imports retry once instead of blanking the page.
experiments.appShellNeed: Critical CSS, route splitting, and resilient router loading
experiments.appShellWhat: Show the header, site notice, clean loading panel, and footer before live Toolhub data finishes loading.
experiments.cacheJobsCurrent: Scheduled jobs poll official recent changes, invalidate affected tool/list/search caches, prewarm important endpoints, and warm recent owner rows.
experiments.cacheJobsNeed: Toolforge jobs for cache_invalidation.py and cache_prewarm.py
experiments.cacheJobsWhat: Keep hot Toolhub endpoints warm so the first user after deploy does not pay the cold-cache cost.
experiments.crawlerCurrent: My tools discovers root/sitemap toolinfo.json URLs before official-first Toolhub registration, and a scheduled source index maps official crawler feeds back to tools.
experiments.crawlerNeed: Toolhub crawler permissions, official crawler source index, safe toolinfo discovery, and local fallback storage
experiments.crawlerWhat: Paste a tool homepage or direct toolinfo.json URL, or paste toolinfo to ingest tools.
experiments.designSystemCurrent: The in-app styleguide documents the current atoms, molecules, organisms, layout patterns, and color tokens used by production pages.
experiments.designSystemWhat: Keep UI components consistent across Toolhub Evolved pages.
experiments.developerSettingsCurrent: Official OAuth app/token tasks link back to Toolhub; Evolved stores local Ed25519 public keys and signing payload helpers.
experiments.developerSettingsNeed: Local author-key API plus official Toolhub developer settings
experiments.developerSettingsWhat: Open official Toolhub developer links and manage Evolved signed-toolinfo public keys.
experiments.diagnosticsCurrent: Responses include X-Toolhub-Evolved-Cache, X-Toolhub-Evolved-Upstream, and Server-Timing; the frontend records boot, labels, API, stale-cache, and refresh timings.
experiments.diagnosticsNeed: Proxy diagnostic headers and frontend timing marks
experiments.diagnosticsWhat: See whether responses came from cache, upstream, stale data, or background refresh.
experiments.docsPagesCurrent: The /api-docs page includes same-origin endpoint forms, formatted JSON output, schema links, and official Toolhub/Wikimedia documentation links.
experiments.docsPagesName: API explorer, toolinfo, and project docs
experiments.docsPagesNeed: Curated GET /api/... explorer plus static documentation pages
experiments.docsPagesWhat: Run curated read-only API requests, inspect responses, copy examples, and read toolinfo/project documentation.
experiments.editAnnosCurrent: Official annotation PUT first; rejected annotations remain local overlays.
experiments.editAnnosWhat: Add community annotations (audiences, tasks, type, icon).
experiments.editToolCurrent: Official PUT when Toolhub permits; rejected edits remain local overlays.
experiments.editToolWhat: Change a tool's core fields (title, description, links…).
experiments.favoritesCurrent: Signed-in changes write to Toolhub favorites; Evolved keeps a local cache/fallback.
experiments.favoritesWhat: Save tools and see them collected in one place.
experiments.feedsCurrent: Local revision/audit rows merged on top of the live feeds.
experiments.feedsWhat: Evolved edits appear at the top of Recent changes, Audit logs and tool history.
experiments.groupContributions: Your contributions — official when possible, local when needed
experiments.groupSignals: Evolved-only signals — real Evolved data only
experiments.healthCurrent: Signed-in users can submit health targets; approved Evolved health records show only real checked status.
experiments.healthNeed: Scheduled health-check job and daily rollups
experiments.healthWhat: A Healthy / Degraded / Down status pill.
experiments.homeDiscoveryCurrent: Home sections read live Toolhub lists/search data and degrade each panel independently if one upstream call fails.
experiments.homeDiscoveryNeed: Live /api/lists/ and /api/search/tools/ reads through the shared proxy cache
experiments.homeDiscoveryWhat: Land on a useful catalog overview with intent filters, featured lists, recent tools, and most-listed tools.
experiments.i18nA11yCurrent: A tiny English label fallback prevents labels.js failures from blanking the app, while tests cover RTL CSS, link routing, and accessible static markup.
experiments.i18nA11yNeed: Locale catalog, built-in fallbacks, theme bootstrap, and accessibility checks
experiments.i18nA11yWhat: Use the app with stable labels, per-field language attributes, RTL-safe CSS, keyboard-accessible navigation, and light/dark themes.
experiments.introLead: The {total} features below describe Toolhub Evolved's hybrid model:
experiments.introLive: live Toolhub data stays the base
experiments.introOverlay: local overlays cover drafts, fallback data, and Evolved-owned data
experiments.introTail: These features are visible by default; for the live-vs-local model and where your data goes, see
experiments.introWrites: supported signed-in writes publish to official Toolhub first, and
experiments.listReadCurrent: Official Toolhub lists are read live; signed-in local drafts and fallbacks are merged only where clearly labeled.
experiments.listReadNeed: GET /api/lists/ and /api/lists/{id}/ plus local list overlay merge
experiments.listReadWhat: Browse published lists and inspect the tools inside a list.
experiments.listsCurrent: Official list create/edit/delete when permitted; local draft lists remain as fallback.
experiments.listsWhat: Create, edit, reorder and delete lists, and add tools to them.
experiments.localPublicToolsCurrent: Approved public local records appear in /v1/search/tools/ and the Evolved /toolinfo.json feed, always labeled as Evolved data.
experiments.localPublicToolsName: Public local tools and toolinfo feed
experiments.localPublicToolsNeed: Moderated local tool records plus public toolinfo.json feed
experiments.localPublicToolsWhat: Expose approved Evolved-local tool records to search and to Toolhub-compatible crawler ingestion.
experiments.maintainerSummaryCurrent: Evolved derives public-safe maintainer summaries from official Toolhub metadata, verified per-tool claims, and local activity rollups without creating a canonical maintainer database.
experiments.maintainerSummaryWhat: Distinguish tools with active maintainers from tools whose source and maintainers both appear stale.
experiments.moderationCurrent: Reviewer/operator roles can list and update pending public local tools, health targets, media, and thanks through moderation endpoints.
experiments.moderationWhat: Review public Evolved-owned records before they appear as public Evolved data.
experiments.myToolsCurrent: Official Toolhub search provides tool candidates; Evolved adds per-tool evidence, indexed crawler feed sources, root/sitemap discovery, and source-analysis reports.
experiments.myToolsNeed: Author-claim table, resolver endpoint, verification providers, official crawler source index, registration workflow, source-analysis reports, and discovery cache
experiments.myToolsWhat: Review tools associated with your signed-in Toolhub identity, register toolinfo sources, and analyze source metadata from one place.
experiments.operationalViewsCurrent: These parity views read official Toolhub endpoints and merge Evolved activity only for local write history where relevant.
experiments.operationalViewsName: Members, crawler history, and audit logs
experiments.operationalViewsWhat: Read Toolhub members, crawler run history, and catalog audit activity.
experiments.permissionsCurrent: Local baseline, reviewer/moderator, and admin/operator roles flow through one backend can(user, action, resource) policy entrypoint.
experiments.permissionsNeed: Toolhub /api/user/ mapping, Evolved role env vars, and backend authz policy
experiments.permissionsWhat: Use Toolhub identity for local permissions without implying official Toolhub admin rights.
experiments.popularityCurrent: Public popularity ranking remains hidden; signed-in tool views now feed real Evolved aggregate events.
experiments.popularityNeed: Daily aggregate rollups and privacy thresholds
experiments.popularityWhat: View counts and a popularity ranking.
experiments.recentTableCurrent: Official /api/recent/ rows render first; Evolved-local activity rows are merged in, and tool owners are enriched progressively through a shared owner cache.
experiments.recentTableWhat: Scan recent activity in a sortable/filterable table with owner, last-updated-by, action, review state, and expandable comments.
experiments.screenshotsCurrent: Signed-in users can submit URL-based screenshots with license/source metadata; approved Evolved media renders on tool pages.
experiments.screenshotsWhat: A preview image strip on the tool page.
experiments.searchBrowseCurrent: Official Toolhub search remains primary; approved Evolved-local public tools appear only in a clearly labeled local strip.
experiments.searchBrowseWhat: Search, facet, sort, paginate, and filter Toolhub tools.
experiments.signinCurrent: Official Toolhub OAuth plus an Evolved server session.
experiments.signinWhat: Sign in through Toolhub OAuth and sign out.
experiments.sourceAnalysisCurrent: My tools accepts selected source files, repository context JSON, or a JSON file bundle, stores redacted evidence reports, and returns toolinfo plus Evolved dependency and assessment metadata suggestions for maintainer review.
experiments.sourceAnalysisNeed: Deterministic analyzer, manifest and lockfile dependency extractors, repository context builder, source_analysis_reports table, private /v1/source-analysis/ endpoints, CLI, and account-workbench UI
experiments.sourceAnalysisWhat: Extract project, API, access-right, dependency, repository-context, OAuth-scope, technology, assessment, and warning signals from maintainer-submitted source bundles.
experiments.syncControlsCurrent: Common badges, field-level provenance labels, validation-error lists, retry buttons, and discard buttons are shared across tool/list write flows.
experiments.syncControlsNeed: Shared sync-status UI plus retry/discard backend endpoints
experiments.syncControlsWhat: See whether each local change is published to Toolhub, saved locally, rejected by Toolhub, pending review, retryable, or discardable.
experiments.thanksCurrent: Signed-in users can thank a tool; approved counts are stored in Evolved and labeled as Evolved data.
experiments.thanksNeed: Burst detection and aggregate daily rollups
experiments.thanksWhat: A lightweight way to appreciate useful tools without rating maintainers' work.
experiments.title: Feature status
experiments.toolDetailsCurrent: Detail and revision data stay live from Toolhub; Evolved overlays add provenance, signals, media, and related-tool UI without replacing canonical records.
experiments.toolDetailsNeed: GET /api/tools/{name}/, revisions, local signal/media endpoints, and graph helpers
experiments.toolDetailsWhat: Inspect tool metadata, links, authors, revisions, related tools, completeness, and a local neighborhood map.
experiments.toolinfoEnrichmentCurrent: The write pipeline can safely fetch a declared toolinfo URL once, merge missing optional fields, and record crawler evidence before fallback or official publish.
experiments.toolinfoEnrichmentNeed: Crawler-safe fetch validation, size limits, and local evidence metadata
experiments.toolinfoEnrichmentWhat: Fetch a submitted toolinfo.json during tool creation to fill available fields and store Evolved evidence.
experiments.toolMapCurrent: Graphs are derived from normalized live Toolhub metadata in the browser and never become a separate canonical dataset.
experiments.toolMapNeed: Client-side similarity graph built from live search/list data
experiments.toolMapWhat: Explore similar tools visually and open quick views from graph nodes or related-tool rows.
experiments.toolRegistrationCurrent: Toolinfo discovery and official crawler registration now live inside the My tools workspace.
experiments.toolRegistrationWhat: Register toolinfo sources and manage local tool records from My tools.
experiments.transparencyCurrent: A compact dismissible site notice links to Feature status and Rules of Engagement; dismissal is stored only in localStorage.
experiments.transparencyNeed: Default-visible site notice, field labels, and Rules of Engagement page
experiments.transparencyWhat: Understand when data is live Toolhub data, Evolved-local data, or an official-first write fallback.
experiments.usageCurrent: Signed-in tool-page interactions are counted as privacy-limited 30-day Evolved usage.
experiments.usageNeed: Daily aggregate rollups and minimum-count suppression
experiments.usageWhat: An “editors used this in the last 30 days” figure.
experiments.writeReviewCurrent: Forms show diffs before official-first writes; supported deletes call Toolhub and report rejection details without losing local state.
experiments.writeReviewNeed: Shared write lifecycle, field validation, and delete adapters
experiments.writeReviewWhat: Preview field-level changes before saving and delete tools/lists from the relevant detail or edit page.

static.about.catalogIntro: Toolhub is a community-managed catalog of software tools used in the Wikimedia movement. Technical volunteers document the tools they build, and all Wikimedians can search the catalog, build lists, and share them.
static.about.cc0:
Structured data is released under CC0; attribution via links back is
		encouraged but not required. Sign in with Toolhub — no separate Evolved account
		or password is needed.
static.about.coreVsAnnotationsBody: Each tool has authoritative core information, editable only by its owner or administrators, plus community annotations that any logged-in Wikimedian can enrich. When both are set for a field, Toolhub shows the core value, balancing maintainer control with community contribution.
static.about.helpBuildBody: Want to help improve this beta or coordinate with upstream Toolhub? See {contribute}.
static.about.howToolsGetHereBody: Tools enter the catalog three ways: by registering a {toolinfo} URL that Toolhub crawls roughly hourly, through the Toolhub UI, or via the API ({postTools}). All paths validate against the same versioned schema, so the data stays consistent.
static.about.prototypeNote: This is a companion interface for Toolhub: it reads live catalog data from the public API, publishes official writes through Toolhub OAuth when you sign in, and keeps Evolved-only additions in its local overlay database.
static.about.title: About Toolhub
static.about.toolDefinition: A "tool" is defined inclusively: user scripts, gadgets, bots, templates, Lua modules, web applications and mobile apps that interact with Wikimedia projects. The catalog aims to be inclusive rather than exclusive, as long as an entry helps people work on the projects.
static.api.evolvedApiDocsItem: Use this prototype's {apiExplorer} for read-only examples, response inspection, and schema pointers.
static.api.intro: Toolhub is built API-first: everything you can do in this interface is also available over a documented HTTP API, so anyone can build their own tools on top of the catalog.
static.api.openApiItem: The OpenAPI schema and endpoints live under {apiRoot}.
static.api.title: API
static.api.writeAccessItem: Read access is anonymous; creating or editing records uses your Wikimedia OAuth identity. For example, {postTools} adds a tool.
static.apiDocs.apiRootDesc: Browse the proxied endpoint index used by this prototype.
static.apiDocs.codegenInputDesc: Use /api/schema/ with OpenAPI Generator, Swagger Codegen, or your language's SDK tooling.
static.apiDocs.diffResponseBody: A diff response contains {original}, {operations}, and {result}. Apply the operations to {original} to obtain {result}; the URL order decides the direction of the comparison.
static.apiDocs.endpointCardDesc: Open the live JSON response through this app's read-only proxy.
static.apiDocs.endpointIndexUnavailable: The live endpoint index is unavailable.
static.apiDocs.heading: API documentation
static.apiDocs.interactiveDocsDesc: Open the canonical Toolhub API documentation.
static.apiDocs.intro: Toolhub is API-first. Evolved reads the live catalog through a same-origin proxy and sends authenticated writes through its own {writePath} official-first lifecycle after Toolhub OAuth sign-in.
static.apiDocs.operationBody: Each operation has an {op} such as {operationNames}. The {path} field is a JSON Pointer inside the versioned document; {value} appears for add, replace, and test, while {from} appears for move and copy. These objects describe historical differences; they are not the payload format for creating or editing tools.
static.apiDocs.readOnlyBoundaryBody: The public proxy exposes anonymous live Toolhub {get} responses for browsing and examples. Authenticated writes never go through that proxy; they use Evolved's CSRF-protected backend bridge so official OAuth tokens stay server-side.
static.apiDocs.revisionDiffBody: Tool and list history endpoints expose revision rows, and their {diff} subresources return what older tickets may call {jsondiff} operations. In the live Toolhub OpenAPI schema these are standard RFC 6902 {jsonPatch} operations.
static.apiDocs.revisionDiffHeading: Revision diffs and JSON Patch operations
static.apiDocs.schemaBody: {schemaEndpoint} returns Toolhub's OpenAPI document. Use the live {liveSchemaUrl} URL when generating a production client, or this prototype's proxied {proxiedSchemaEndpoint} when you want to inspect the same document without leaving this site.
static.apiDocs.title: API documentation — Toolhub
static.apiDocs.toolinfoFieldReferenceDes: Read the field meanings, core versus annotation boundary, and controlled values.
static.apiDocs.toolinfoSchemaBody: Toolhub validates registered {toolinfo} files against schema version {version}. Required fields are name, title, description, and url; use _schema to identify the toolinfo schema version when you publish a file.
static.apiDocs.toolinfoSchemaDesc: Open the official 1.2.2 schema source used for crawled toolinfo.json files.
static.codeOfConduct.cocLink: Code of Conduct for Wikimedia technical spaces
static.codeOfConduct.expectedA11yItem: Treat accessibility, localization, privacy, and newcomer usability as core project quality concerns.
static.codeOfConduct.expectedGoodFaithIt: Assume good faith, be specific in feedback, and separate critique of the interface from critique of contributors.
static.codeOfConduct.expectedNoHarassmen: Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language, and pressure to expose private information are not acceptable.
static.codeOfConduct.intro: Toolhub Evolved expects participation to follow the spirit of the {codeOfConduct}. This beta is not an official Wikimedia Foundation venue, but it is built for Wikimedia contributors and should stay compatible with Wikimedia technical-space norms.
static.codeOfConduct.reportingBody: For Evolved-specific project conduct in the GitHub repository, use {issues} when public reporting is appropriate. For Wikimedia technical spaces, follow the official reporting paths in the Code of Conduct. For threats of harm, contact local authorities first, then {emergency}.

static.healthScore.accessibilityComponen: {frontendAccessibility}; not applicable when no web-facing frontend technology is detected.
static.healthScore.catalogVariablesItem: Cached official Toolhub catalog data supplies tool identity and maintainer metadata such as {name}, authors, maintainers, tool type, repository URL, documentation URLs, keywords, license, deprecation state, and listing modified timestamp.
static.healthScore.clampValue: Each component and dimension score is clamped to {range}.
static.healthScore.codeReferenceBody: The public score is assembled in {publicFile}. Source-analysis health core and component scoring are implemented in {sourceFile}.
static.healthScore.componentRulesBody: The source analyzer starts each component from a fixed base value, applies the deterministic adjustments below, then clamps the result to the 0 to 100 range.
static.healthScore.dependencyHealthRules: +20 for a dependency manifest; +15 for publishable dependency findings, otherwise -20; +15 for a lockfile or locked dependency evidence; -10 when dependencies are inferred only from imports and no manifest exists.
static.healthScore.exampleBody: If a tool has source-health 88 and maintainer-status 100, with no included runtime-health dimension, the public score is reproduced as follows.
static.healthScore.filtersBody: Source findings only affect scoring when they pass the publishable evidence filter. This prevents weak examples, fixtures, and low-confidence strings from counting the same as runtime or manifest evidence.
static.healthScore.frontendAccessibility: Only created for JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue, or MediaWiki gadget tools. +20 for accessibility markup or tests; +20 for an axe dependency; +10 for tests.
static.healthScore.gradeValue: Legendary ({strong}) >= 85; Great ({good}) >= 70; Needs attention ({needsAttention}) >= 50; Unmaintained ({highRisk}) < 50; Unknown ({unknown}) when no score exists.
static.healthScore.intro: This page is the reproducibility spec for Evolved health scores. A user should be able to take the public summary JSON for a tool, apply the formulas below, and arrive at the same score shown in the interface.
static.healthScore.maintainerBaseRule: Start with {bestConfidence}, the highest public maintainer edge confidence for the tool.
static.healthScore.maintainerClampRule: The final value is clamped to {range}.
static.healthScore.maintainerEmptyRule: If {maintainers} is 0, the dimension has no score and is excluded.
static.healthScore.maintainerStatusInclu: At least one maintainer edge exists and bestConfidence is numeric.
static.healthScore.maintainerStatusSourc: Starts from {bestConfidence}, then applies the activity and verification adjustments below.
static.healthScore.maintainerVariablesIt: Evolved maintainer indexing supplies maintainer count, verified maintainer count, active maintainer count, evidence edge count, best confidence, last maintainer activity age, recent activity count, active tool count, and verified tool count.
static.healthScore.maintainerVerificatio: If {verifiedMaintainers} is greater than 0, add 5 points.
static.healthScore.maintenanceActivityRu: Repository status from last commit age: {active} <= 90 days adds 30, {quiet} <= 365 days adds 10, {stale} <= 730 days subtracts 20, {dormant} > 730 days subtracts 35. Contributor count >= 2 adds 10; contributor count = 1 subtracts 10; commit count < 5 subtracts 10.
static.healthScore.maintenanceReadinessR: +20 for README; +10 for license; +15 for tests; +15 for CI; +10 for changelog, contributing, security, or owners documentation; +10 for repository metadata.
static.healthScore.metadataCompletenessR: +15 each for publishable projects, APIs, technology, and dependencies; +10 for README documentation; +10 for license documentation.
static.healthScore.noLiveCallsItem: Page load does not call GitHub, Gerrit, Toolforge, package registries, or a live tool endpoint to calculate a score. It reads stored Evolved summaries.
static.healthScore.noLlmItem: No large language model output is used to calculate the score.
static.healthScore.noPopularityItem: Popularity, page views, thanks, subjective ratings, and manual editorial preference are not part of the score.
static.healthScore.noSecretsItem: Raw source files and secrets are not stored in the public summary. The analyzer stores bounded, redacted findings and evidence excerpts.
static.healthScore.operationalReadinessR: +20 for runtime or deployment configuration; +20 when Toolforge context is detected; +15 for a health-check signal or declared health URL; +10 for CI.
static.healthScore.permissionClarityRule: If no publishable access evidence exists, keep 55. If write-capable access exists, set 65, then +15 for authentication, -25 without authentication, +10 for inferred OAuth scopes, and -20 for administrator access. If only read-oriented access exists, set 90. Declared OAuth scopes add +5; inferred scopes missing from declarations subtract 15.
static.healthScore.publicScoreBody: The public score is calculated from {healthDimensions}. Only dimensions where {included} is true and {score} is numeric are used in the numerator and denominator.
static.healthScore.repositoryStatusValue: {active}: age <= 90 days; {quiet}: age <= 365 days; {stale}: age <= 730 days; {dormant}: age > 730 days; {unknown}: no age.
static.healthScore.repositoryVariablesIt: Trusted repository context supplies repository URL, provider, branch, default branch, last commit timestamp, commit id, commit count, contributor count, tag, dirty state, and analysis timestamp.
static.healthScore.roundingValue: The backend uses Python {round}; exact .5 ties follow Python's nearest-even behavior.
static.healthScore.runtimeHealthIncluded: An enabled, approved Evolved health target exists and its latest status maps to a numeric score.
static.healthScore.runtimeHealthSource: Uses the stored {lastStatus} for the approved health-check target.
static.healthScore.runtimeVariablesItem: Evolved runtime checks supply target URL, latest status, last checked timestamp, and last stored error when an approved health target exists.
static.healthScore.securityReviewRules: Warnings subtract points: {credential}: -35, {administrator}: -20, {writeWithoutAuth}: -20. Authentication evidence adds +5; security documentation adds +5.
static.healthScore.sourceHealthIncluded: The latest approved source-analysis report has a numeric healthCore score.
static.healthScore.sourceHealthSource: Uses {field} from the latest approved {report} report.
static.healthScore.sourceMaintainerActiv: Computed directly from trusted {maintainerActivity} context; excluded when the status is {unknown}.

{active}: 85, {quiet}: 70, {stale}: 40, {dormant}: 20, {unknown}: no score. Active maintainer count >= 2 adds 10; active maintainer count = 0 subtracts 15; maintainer count >= 2 adds 5; maintainer count = 0 subtracts 25; recent activity count > 0 adds 5.
static.healthScore.sourceScoreBody: {sourceHealth} is itself a weighted score from the latest approved deterministic source-analysis report. Component dimensions with more than one component first take the rounded mean of their component scores.
static.healthScore.sourceVariablesItem: Source analysis supplies detected Wikimedia projects, API actions, OAuth scopes, access-right classes, credential warnings, dependencies, lockfiles, manifests, CI evidence, tests, docs, frontend accessibility evidence, source file classes, and suggested toolinfo metadata.
static.healthScore.sourceWeightsCaption: Source class weights used by publishable finding filters
static.healthScore.summaryEndpoint: Use {endpoint} to inspect the public calculation payload. The visible tooltip on each health score exposes the same dimensions.
static.healthScore.title: Health score system

static.privacy.oauthItem: If you sign in, the beta uses official Toolhub OAuth and stores a local session plus a server-side OAuth grant. It never asks for or stores your Wikimedia password.
static.privacy.officialWritesItem: When an action is sent to official Toolhub, Toolhub's own API receives the request and applies Toolhub attribution, permissions, validation, logging, and retention rules.

static.rulesOfEngagement.catalogSync: How the catalog cache is maintained
static.rulesOfEngagement.catalogSyncBack: The initial backfill processes at most five pages of 100 records every 15 minutes, with at least three seconds between upstream requests. A persistent cursor resumes after interruptions and advances until the first complete catalog cycle finishes.
static.rulesOfEngagement.catalogSyncReco: As a safety net, one catalog page is reconciled every 12 hours. This spreads a full reconciliation across roughly a month for a catalog of several thousand tools instead of repeatedly reingesting the whole catalog.
static.rulesOfEngagement.catalogSyncStea: After that first cycle, Evolved checks the newest Toolhub recent-change page every 15 minutes and fetches only changed tool details. It processes at most 20 changed details per run; failed details remain in a retry queue.
static.rulesOfEngagement.futureSignalsBo: Future Evolved-only signals such as popularity, thanks, health, usage, and screenshots stay hidden until they have real backend data. They do not ship as fixtures or generated values.
static.rulesOfEngagement.honestEdgesBody: Because search is still based on Toolhub's live search API, a locally saved draft may not appear in live search until it has been accepted by official Toolhub. We label local overlays rather than presenting them as canonical Toolhub data.
static.rulesOfEngagement.intro: This is a companion interface on a separate domain, not the official Toolhub frontend. It exists to run next to Toolhub: live Toolhub data remains the base, while Evolved adds a local overlay for extra and fallback data.
static.rulesOfEngagement.noticeItem: The site notice can be dismissed with its close button; that only hides the notice in this browser and does not change where data is stored.
static.rulesOfEngagement.officialWritesI: Signed-in supported writes go first to official Toolhub. If Toolhub rejects a write, Evolved keeps it locally as a draft or overlay where the feature supports that.
static.rulesOfEngagement.repositoryAnaly: Repository analysis is deterministic and runs only for canonical tools with an eligible public HTTPS repository URL. Evolved allows GitHub, GitLab, Wikimedia GitLab, Wikimedia Gerrit, Codeberg, and Bitbucket hosts; it performs shallow non-recursive Git checkouts, does not execute repository code, removes symlinks before traversal, caps checkout size, and stores redacted findings tied to the observed commit. The scheduled worker checks at most 100 repository candidates per hour and skips unchanged commits.
static.rulesOfEngagement.signedOutItem: Signed-out users can read live Toolhub data, but create/update/delete actions require Toolhub sign-in.
static.rulesOfEngagement.summary: In short: Toolhub remains the source of truth for catalog data; Evolved publishes through Toolhub when signed in and keeps local overlay data for drafts, fallback, and features Toolhub does not expose.
static.rulesOfEngagement.title: Rules of Engagement
static.rulesOfEngagement.verifiedClaimsB: My tools and signed-toolinfo verification are Evolved-local evidence layers. A verified claim is always per tool: being verified for one tool does not verify the same display name everywhere, and Evolved reviewer/operator roles never grant official Toolhub admin or write rights.
static.rulesOfEngagement.whatsEvolvedBod: Evolved additions are visible by default. Some have real official write paths when you are signed in: favorites, lists, direct tool submissions, core edits where Toolhub permits them, community annotations, and crawler URL registration.
static.rulesOfEngagement.whatsRealBody: The catalog itself is genuine: user-facing tools, search, facets, tool details, lists, members, recent changes, crawler history, and audit logs come from {toolhub} through the read proxy. Evolved also keeps a server-side canonical cache of official tool records for background enrichment and resilience; that cache is rebuildable, is not the source of truth, and never replaces live Toolhub authority. When you sign in with Toolhub, supported writes are sent back to the official Toolhub API using your OAuth grant.
static.signIn.devLoginNote: Local dev sign-in creates an Evolved-only test session. Official Toolhub writes stay unavailable.
static.signIn.oauthNote: Toolhub Evolved signs you in with official Toolhub OAuth, then uses Toolhub's user API to identify you locally.
static.signIn.readOnlyNote: Official writes still follow Toolhub's permissions. Evolved keeps supported rejected writes locally as drafts or overlays so you can revise them.
static.terms.betaDisclaimer: Toolhub Evolved is an individual-run beta on Toolforge, not a Wikimedia Foundation-operated service. It aims to behave consistently with the {termsOfUse}, but the Wikimedia Foundation Terms of Use are the authoritative terms for official Toolhub, Wikimedia accounts, and Wikimedia project activity.
static.terms.contributionTerms: Structured Toolhub catalog data is made available under CC0. Evolved source code is published separately in {source}. Tools listed here are owned and operated by their respective maintainers; this beta catalogs and enriches metadata but does not host or endorse the tools.
static.terms.experimentalItem: The interface is experimental and may change, fail, or remove Evolved-only data while features are being developed.
static.terms.noSecretsItem: Do not submit secrets, private credentials, or confidential data. Tool metadata, source-analysis input, and community annotations should describe public tools.
static.terms.officialActionsItem: Actions that publish to official Toolhub are still subject to Toolhub permissions, audit history, validation, and Wikimedia account rules.
static.terms.readFullTerms: For authoritative Wikimedia legal terms, read the full {termsOfUse}.
static.terms.title: Terms of Use
